blurb: Guests fly in hot air balloons over Idaho, experiencing scenic views including sunrise and fall foliage. Flights can be private, for families, groups, or business events, with options for in-flight ceremonies. The company has a long family history in ballooning and offers gift certificates.
extraNote: Gift card sales are final and non-refundable. · Your confirmation email will include links to reschedule or cancel your flight with at least 72 hours’ notice. · Cancellations made within 72 hours of your scheduled flight are non-refundable. · If we need to cancel due to weather or operational reasons, you will receive a gift certificate to reschedule for a future date. · If you are visiting from out of state and cannot reschedule, please reach out to us and we will issue a full refund. ##We look forward to seeing you! · We look forward to seeing you!
